# Template: Web Application

> For projects with a frontend + backend server.

## Questions

1. Frontend framework? (React, Vue, Svelte, Astro, etc.)
2. Backend framework? (FastAPI, Django, Express, Next.js, etc.)
3. Database? (PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL, MongoDB, etc.)
4. CSS approach? (Tailwind, plain CSS, component library, etc.)

## Generated Files

- `spec.md` — auth, CRUD, UI requirements with user stories
- `architecture.md` — client-server architecture, API routes, data flow diagram
- `tech-stack.md` — frontend + backend + database + build tooling
- `environment.md` — separate env setup for frontend/ and backend/ if multi-project

## Structure

```
project/
  frontend/       ← frontend app
  backend/        ← API server
  project_info/   ← project context
```
